## tmh events list

List all events

### Synopsis

Returns a list of the organization's events from the last 30 days, oldest first. Pass the last `eventId` you processed as `after` to resume where you stopped, and `type` to list one event type.

--all follows every page, keeping the other flags, and prints all the items as one JSON array, so `| jq` works; add --ndjson to print one compact item per line as each page arrives.

Scopes: webhooks:manage or audit:read

```
tmh events list [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --after nextCursor   Return events after this event id (exclusive). The previous page's nextCursor. (also --cursor)
      --all                follow every page and print all the items as one JSON array; --limit sets the page size
  -h, --help               help for list
      --limit int          How many objects to return, between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20.
      --ndjson             with --all, print one compact JSON item per line as each page arrives
      --type string        Filter to one event type; one of: enrollment.certified, seat.consumed, seat.freed, learner.invited, learner.started, learner.certified, learner.expiring, learner.expired, learner.removed, invite.bounced, certificate.revoked, seats.low
```
